name: Shan Sushi
address: 107 York St, George Central, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: Fresh sushi and Japanese classics in George's city centre, blending quality ingredients with friendly service.
description_long:
Tucked into York Street in the heart of George, Shan Sushi has built a loyal following for its fresh sushi platters and authentic Japanese fare. The relaxed atmosphere makes it equally suited for a quick lunch or a leisurely dinner, with generous portions that won't break the bank.

The menu covers all the classics — from California rolls to salmon roses — alongside tempura, noodle dishes, and bento boxes. Regulars rave about the freshness of the fish and the attention to detail in presentation. It's a straightforward spot without pretension, where the focus stays firmly on good food and welcoming service.

Conveniently located in George Central, it's an easy stop whether you're a local craving sushi or passing through the Garden Route. The mid-range pricing and consistent quality have made it a go-to for Japanese food in the area.
